我第一次見到 Ohsnap MCON 手掣係去年 CES 嘅時候，當下就即刻愛上呢個概念。個設計好簡單：畀你一個功能齊全嘅手提遊戲手掣，可以透過 MagSafe 吸附喺你部手機上面，要用嘅時候就彈開，唔用嘅時候就收埋變成一個細細件、去邊都帶得去嘅嘢。過去兩個星期，我用佢嚟做咗一輪測試。我不斷掟佢、撳咗彈出掣成幾百次、又用佢嚟玩模擬器、Apple Arcade 遊戲同多部唔同嘅手機。以下係佢嘅實際表現，以及你需要知道嘅所有嘢。

一定要睇我哋條片，等你可以真正睇到呢個手掣點運作！

第一眼睇落，MCON 望落好似一個大碼嘅 MagSafe 充電池。前面係一個可調校嘅磁吸圓盤，用嚟放你部手機，所有掣、搖桿同手柄都好好地收埋喺圓盤後面。有幾個主要規格值得留意：

Kickback 模式

但未完。佢仲有第二種玩法，叫做 Kickback 模式。顧名思義，你可以將你部手機擺住嘅金屬 MagSafe 板拆出嚟，嗰塊板本身就內置一個支架。你就可以將手機以支架模式放喺枱面，再用無線方式連接手掣嚟玩，有種 Switch 般嘅手提遊戲機體驗。如果你唔想成日揹住成個手掣連埋部手機，Kickback 模式可以將重量大幅減低。

MCON 手掣適用於任何支援 MagSafe 嘅 iPhone，以及任何內置磁吸環或裝咗磁吸殼嘅 Android 手機。包裝入面佢哋仲附送一個磁吸環，等你可以貼喺冇 MagSafe 嘅裝置上面。MCON 兼容支援手掣嘅手機遊戲、Apple Arcade、模擬器、Steam Link、PlayStation Remote Play、GeForce Now 以及 Xbox 串流遊戲。而家等我講下我嘅使用體驗。

我的使用體驗

當然，第一樣令我印象深刻嘅係佢哋嘅造工真係做得好好。佢哋巧妙咁結合咗磁鐵、金屬同塑膠，拎上手感覺好實淨。一般有咁多活動部件嘅嘢，好多時都會有啲位卡住或者要妥協，但我完全冇遇到呢個情況。由使用滑動機關，到拆開同裝返金屬板用 KickBack 模式，每一步都好自然。我亦都好鍾意佢個實體開關掣，開關手掣超方便，等你可以輕鬆配對任何裝置。配對好之後，每次開機都會自動連接返最近用過嘅裝置。

我用咗三個主要場景嚟測試呢個手掣。第一個係 Xbox 雲端遊戲。我喺 Xbox 上面玩好多 NCAA 足球遊戲，所以我想睇下用 MCON 喺 iPhone 上面玩 NCAA 嘅體驗係點。手掣輕鬆畀到我一個喺掌心做到嘅主機級遊戲體驗，真係好正。之後我用佢玩 Apple Arcade 上面嘅《Madden 27》。呢隻遊戲本身原生支援 MFI 手掣，所以一樣完美運行。講真，因為零延遲，體驗仲好過雲端遊戲。全新嘅《Madden 27》對於任何想喺街上面解決想玩 Madden 主機級體驗嘅朋友嚟講，都係一個好選擇。最後我用佢嚟做一個比較輕鬆嘅 Game Boy 模擬器用途。我好鍾意喺 iPhone 上面玩我嘅寵物小精靈遊戲。因為我用嘅模擬器完全支援外置手掣，所以一樣玩得順暢。

我連續玩咗接近兩個鐘嘅遊戲，重複咗好幾次，完全冇手部疲勞感覺。我亦都用咗 Kickback 模式，非常舒服。用摺疊手機嘅話，Kickback 模式效果仲好，因為你會有一個超大嘅畫面嚟打機。

我發現嘅唯一缺點係手掣冇辦法幫你部 iPhone 充電。冇 MagSafe 或者有線充電功能畀你部 iPhone 用。除此之外，呢個手掣對我嘅用途嚟講真係好正。

售價與發售

Ohsnap MCON 手掣而家喺 Ohsnap 官網做緊優惠，售價 99 美元（原價 149 美元）。備有黑、白兩色。仲有幾件配件可以一齊買，包括一個收納盒、一個類似 Switch 底座可以駁去電視嘅配件，同埋其他幾件值得留意嘅嘢。

According to the latest issue of the *Power On* newsletter, Apple has been considering adding a feature to the Apple Upgrade programme that would make setting up an iPhone almost seamless: Apple would pre-load your data onto the new device. However, the feature never came to fruition.

The concept is simple: since users upgrade their devices on a regular monthly payment plan, why not make the switch as painless as possible? Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports:

There are clearly some issues with this. First, your iCloud backup would be slightly out of date, since the data transfer can only happen at the time of shipment, which would be a few days behind — unless you choose to pick up in store.

On top of that, there are obvious privacy concerns. If you already use iCloud backups, the fact that Apple has your data shouldn't come as a surprise. But for the general public, there could be concerns about how the data is transferred to the new phone, and whether anyone could peek at it along the way.

Two years ago, Apple launched a new system in its retail stores called Presto, which allows staff to update the software on an iPhone while it's still in its box. It's conceivable that this system could later be extended to support iCloud backup transfers, with no one ever needing to touch your data.

Still, the feature never launched, and that might be for the better.

「如果我開冷氣，我會通知大家」

關於林超英對抗暑熱，公眾最關心的是他開不開冷氣，林超英在周日清晨，首先發文說：「天氣熱，怎麼辦？風扇、窗簾、氣流、一級能源標籤冷氣機（後備）、27度。今年暫時未開冷氣，如果我開冷氣，我會通知大家，請不必來問。」

林超英：取消了也沒分別

網民「不必來問」，但接下來的下午，香港迎來史上最熱的高溫，天文台錄得36.9度，是1884年有紀錄以來的最高氣溫。勞工處發出黃色工作暑熱警告，原因是雖然8.9氣溫特別高，但相對濕度低於夏天平日情況，加上風速條件良好，天文台在十個地點量度的「香港暑熱指數」，大部分介乎30至少於32，勞工處因此根據機制，發出黃色暑熱警告。

不過，林超英並不認同。他下午先在Facebook說：「熱到這個破紀錄的樣子，還只是黃色工作暑熱警告，加上中暑不列為工傷，看來這個制度取消了也沒有甚麼分別。」

九個監測站　四個達標會發警告

勞工處晚上回覆《集誌社》查詢指，天文台今年四月發布更多地區的暑熱指數數據，勞工處已在4月20日起，進一步優化「工作暑熱警告」系統，加入更多地區的暑熱指數數據，作為發出「工作暑熱警告」的準則。除了沿用京士柏量度的「香港暑熱指數」數據，也加入其他九個地點的數據，作為發出「工作暑熱警告」的準則。

勞工處指，若其他九個「香港暑熱指數」監測站，有四個或以上顯示，香港多個地點的暑熱壓力情況，已達某個級別，即使京士柏的指數未達到該水平，勞工處仍會發出對應的「工作暑熱警告」。勞工處指，會密切留意暑熱天氣及「工作暑熱警告」系統的運作，檢視系統是否需要再作進一步優化。

勞工處：暑熱壓力致傷亡，僱主負補償責任

林超英說中暑不當工傷，勞工處指，僱員如在受僱工作期間，因工遭遇意外以致受傷或死亡（包括因工作暑熱壓力意外導致的受傷或死亡），僱主須負起補償責任。一宗個案屬工傷與否，以及僱主須否負上僱員補償責任，需要按個別個案的事實和具體情況，及客觀環境而考慮，不能一概而論。

「紅色警告指標顯然定得太高」

晚上，氣溫達32度，流浮山逾34度，林超英再度發文，批評勞工處的工作暑熱警告指標，跑馬地、上水、元朗、西貢，都達37度、上水差點40度，「這樣的水深火熱中，工作暑熱警告只是黃色，真的令人迷茫」。他也回應勞工處稱按「香港暑熱指數」發警告的說法，指「程序也許無誤」，「紅色警告指標顯然定得太高，連氣溫破紀錄都出不了，豈不是只是用來裝飾櫥窗的陳列品？」他又反駁勞工處所指「香港暑熱指數」的漏洞。他解釋，「市民大部份時間在室內活動，香港暑熱指數內太陽曝曬的份量很少，不適用於露天工作處境。」

建議採用「濕球黑球溫度」為參數

他建議採用國際通用的「濕球黑球溫度」（Wet Bulb Globe Temperature）為參數，因這能涵蓋太陽曝露對人體加熱的因素。他又說，黃色工作暑熱警告已經發出200多次，紅色則一次都沒有，「是否有點奇怪」？他要求勞工處向公眾解釋，紅色警告指標的科學根據。

向勞工處分享經驗

任內發明了暴雨警告的林超英也向勞工處分享經驗指，天文台訂定暴雨警告指標時，準則是「黑色約一年一次，紅色一年三次，黃色一年十次」，「這樣就不會有永遠不發出的警告」。

Earlier this summer, Apple hiked prices significantly due to the ongoing global memory crisis. Examples include the iPad Air going from $599 to $749, the M5 MacBook Pro from $1,699 to $1,999, and the Apple TV from $129 to $199. The above are just some examples — the key point is that the magnitude of this round of price increases is quite staggering.

This raises a question — will Apple make bold improvements to its products so that they remain attractive at their new prices?

Of course, some Apple products are about to undergo major revamps, with the MacBook Pro and iPad mini being two of them. However, for products without significant updates, I don't think Apple can sell last-generation technology at much higher prices while still making people feel it's worth buying — especially compared to the current state of the second-hand market.

If you could buy an M4 iPad Air for $599 (or even as low as $499) a few months ago, why would you want to pay $749 now? The higher the price, the more obvious this contradiction becomes.

Some Apple products haven't seen major changes for a long time. The iPad Air has used the same design and feature set since 2020, with only chip upgrades and Apple Pencil Pro support added during that period. The base-model iPad has largely remained the same from 2022 to now, and the iMac has been the same from 2021 to now as well.

Do these products need a complete redesign? Not necessarily. But I think Apple could do something to make them more appealing at their current prices. For example, putting a miniLED display on the iMac, upgrading the iPad Air to 120Hz, and giving the base-model iPad a fully laminated display.

Compared to price increases, the cost of these upgrades is relatively low, but should make consumers feel much more comfortable paying the new prices. Conversely, Apple may also lower the specifications of some products to offset the price hikes. For example, the iPhone may return to 128GB of storage.

去年9月蘋果推出iPhone 17時，就開始倒數這款新旗艦機何時打破一項15年前創下的紀錄。該紀錄需要超過一年才能被打破，但根據目前的傳聞，iPhone 17將會成為首款奪冠的機型。

iPhone 4擁有異常長的銷售期

這項紀錄屬於iPhone 4，該機於2010年6月開賣，並一直穩坐蘋果頂級iPhone的地位至2011年10月。由於蘋果當年將旗艦機的發佈週期由夏季改為秋季，iPhone 4在這個位置上停留了接近16個月。

對於打算「等待iPhone 5」的消費者來說，那是一段格外令人沮喪的時期。蘋果最終推出外觀幾乎與iPhone 4一模一樣的iPhone 4S。改變全在內部：Siri首次登場，相機有所改進，效能亦有所提升。

iPhone 4技術上亦經歷過多次發佈節奏。美國方面，AT&T是iPhone的獨家電訊商，並率先發售此機；六個月後，Verizon成為美國第二間合作電訊商；再之後，經歷10個月波折後才姍姍來遲的白色版本終於面世。

自此之後，再無iPhone能夠複製iPhone 4長達15個月的旗艦機銷售紀錄。最接近的是iPhone 11 Pro，在iPhone 12因疫情延期推出下佔據了13個月的龍頭位置。其他特殊例子亦存在，例如iPhone SE至SE 2、再到iPhone 16e之間的空白期，每段均長達四年以上，但這些均屬刻意安排，並非旗艦機週期。

預期iPhone 18要到2027年春季才會面世。這意味著iPhone 17將會在蘋果主力產品線的頂端停留約18個月，超越iPhone 4的紀錄，並為歷來最長的標準版iPhone銷售期樹立新基準。

Local weather is one of the most underappreciated variables in Apple Home smart home automation setups. Over the past few years, I've used all sorts of sensors, from alerting about dripping faucets in freezing weather to adjusting sprinkler timing with Eve Aqua on hot days. The Eve Weather has been part of my setup for a while, and since it gained Matter support a few years ago, it has been incredibly useful around the home.

HomeKit Weekly is a column series focused on smart home accessories, automation tips, and information related to the Apple smart home framework.

If you've been following HomeKit Weekly for a while, you'll know I'm a big fan of automations that just run on their own. Smart home accessories that can't perform tasks automatically are basically useless. That's exactly why I've always recommended building a smart home around a single ecosystem rather than mixing and matching products from different brands. Even in the Matter era, I don't want to juggle a bunch of different platforms. For me, the answer is Apple Home. I lean toward Eve devices because they've always taken privacy seriously, and as long as you stick with local control via Matter, you can skip the requirement of setting up a mandatory cloud account. Eve has also been actively supporting Matter and Thread in recent years, which is exactly the kind of development people want to see.

The Eve Weather packs three sets of data into one compact device: temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure. It has an IPX4 water resistance rating, and its aluminum housing design makes it look right at home outdoors. Mine is mounted on the side of the house. What it provides are hyper-localized readings, which often differ by several degrees from what the Apple Weather app reports. Honestly, depending on whether it's extremely hot or bitterly cold, that difference really matters. When your pipes are freezing at 31 degrees Fahrenheit but your app says 34, you'll be glad you installed a local sensor.

One of the Eve Weather's most underrated features is its built-in 12-hour weather trend display. It uses barometric pressure changes to forecast weather shifts. You'll see a visual icon showing whether it's likely to be sunny, cloudy, rainy, or stormy. This small touch adds a lot to the overall device, and you don't need to open a phone app—just glance up and you can see it at a glance.

Here are a few automation examples you can build with the Eve Weather:

  • When the temperature drops below freezing, turn on a colored light to remind household members to let the faucets drip.
  • When outdoor humidity is particularly high, turn on the dehumidifier.
  • If it has already rained and the forecast calls for more rain, pause the sprinkler system.
  • Without leaving the house, ask Siri to report the current temperature in the front yard.

Matter and Thread Support in 2026

A few years ago, Eve rolled out a free firmware update that added Matter support to the Eve Weather. If you already own the device, you can upgrade it through the Eve app. The Matter version supports Apple Home as well as Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and SmartThings. The sensor itself is identical—it just becomes cross-platform compatible, so if you ever want to switch to a different primary smart home ecosystem in the future, the device won't be left obsolete.

The Eve Weather is what's known as a Minimal Thread Device. That means it communicates via Thread but doesn't relay signals. That job is handled by some always-on "Full Thread Devices," such as the Eve Energy or Eve Water Guard. The more "Full Thread Devices" you have, the stronger and more stable your Thread network will be, and battery-powered devices like the Eve Weather benefit directly from that stability.

You also still don't need to set up an Eve account. Unless you opt in yourself, everything stays local. Eve's iPhone app is an excellent tool for visualizing and tracking historical trends in temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity. Using it to identify patterns and make smarter decisions about things like lawn irrigation and energy management is genuinely enjoyable.

I have several HomePod minis placed around the house, and I also rely on my Eero 6E network to support Thread. Eero has Thread support built in at the software level, so it provides a solid foundation for devices like the Eve Weather, ensuring stable connections and snappy responses.

Eve Weather Wrap-Up

The only improvement I'd still love to see is a rechargeable battery. The current battery lasts a few months, but I'd much prefer a USB-C port like the Eve Room has. That said, the Eve Weather remains one of my favorite Apple Home accessories. It's simply designed, looks great, and thanks to Matter, it works well across all the major platforms. If you're looking to bring local weather data into your smart home system and trigger all sorts of practical automations, the Eve Weather is an easy recommendation from me.

You can pick one up on Amazon or directly from the Eve Store.

47 人案 45 名被告串謀顛覆國家政權罪成，當中 12 名被告提出上訴，今年 2 月被上訴庭駁回，其中 11 人再向高院上訴庭申請，上訴至終審法院的許可證明書。上訴庭今（10日）頒下決定，同意涉案法律論點具重大而廣泛重要性，考慮到是終審法院首次就相關法律議題作裁決，批准 11 人向終審法院上訴。

47人案中，12 名被告就定罪和判刑提出上訴，在今年 2 月被駁回；其中 11 人再提出上訴至終審法院，今獲上訴庭批准。（資料相片）

上訴人為楊雪盈、黃碧雲、鄒家成、余慧明、何桂藍、林卓廷、吳政亨、鄭達鴻、何啟明、陳志全、梁國雄。申請由首席法官潘兆初、上訴庭法官彭偉昌及法官譚耀豪處理。

上訴庭今年 2 月頒下判詞，認為正確詮釋下，《國安法》22 條下的「其他非法手段」，不限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」及刑事行為；又審視特區憲制秩序、立法會憲制職能及議員維護《基本法》的責任，認為涉案謀劃旨在迫中央政府結束一國兩制，顛覆憲制秩序，屬非法手段，而涉案連串行為屬被禁行為、立法會不干預原則不適用，被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制及其後果，具有特定顛覆意圖。至於《基本法》是否容許議員透過否決預算案逼特首問責，上訴庭指具重大憲制意義，但各方陳詞「流於表面」而不作定論。

上訴庭：部分論點未顧及事實背景及法庭裁決

上訴庭今歸納上訴方提出的 5 個議題，包括《國安法》22 條下「其他非法手段」的正確詮釋為何；觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制是否構成「其他非法手段」；立法會議員的憲制責任、權力及職能是什麼，及涉案「連串行為」是否「受禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；及意圖觸發《基本法》50 至 52 條機制，是否構成顛覆政權的特定意圖。上訴庭指，上述論點顯然與上訴理據大幅相似，但部分似乎未有充分顧及本案的事實背景及法庭裁決。

上訴庭指，考慮雙方書面陳詞後，認為判決所涉的主要議題，具有重大而廣泛重要性，當中涉及《國安法》第 22 條的控罪元素，包括犯罪行為及犯罪意圖；以及立法會議員履行憲制職能的責任，特別是關於審核財政預算案及啟動《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制的事宜。上訴庭指，相關爭議值得終審法院考慮，尤其這是終審法院首次就相關事宜作出裁決。

就五項法律議題批終極上訴許可證明書

上訴庭遂就以下 5 個議題，批出上訴至終審法院的許可證明書，包括按照國安法 22 條，何謂「其他非法手段」，是否只局限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」或刑事行為；涉案的「謀劃」或「連串行為」是否條文所指的「非法手段」及「被禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；以及被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條所訂機制及其帶來的後果，是否懷有特定的顛覆意圖。

iPhone 18 Pro 零件成本將增加 38%

新生產一部裝置的成本大致可分為三部分：零件、組裝，以及間接費用。最後一類涵蓋範圍甚廣，由新裝置的研發到市場推廣活動的費用都包括在內。

這是一個很大的轉變。僅僅在去年，螢幕還是 iPhone 入面最貴的零件；今年，記憶體將會取而代之成為最貴的零件。

「某部門」反對公開數據 改制「香港暑熱指數」

林超英重申應使用濕球、黑球温度指標，他憶述，當年有關的公式，接近定好，天文台曾準備向香港公開這項數據，但受到「某部門」反對，有些擔憂公布濕球、黑球温度引起，會勞工界注意，所以要求天文台另制一個不適用於露天情況的指標出來，這就是今天政府引用的「香港暑熱指數」。

林超英指，兩者絕對不相似。香港暑熱指數，避開了露天工作情況，沒處理露天太陽曬的情況。他指出，所有的數個，都是用三組數字，分別為氣温、黑球、濕球温度，只是比重不同。

A Bloomberg report yesterday suggested that the future Apple Watch lineup could see a significant shake-up.

It specifically mentioned that Apple is exploring the possibility of launching one or more models with a round face design instead of a square one…

Most smartwatches are round

Although square-faced watches have existed for over a hundred years, most traditional watches are round, and the same applies to Android smartwatches. Examples include:

  • Amazfit Active Max
  • Samsung Galaxy Watch 9
  • Motorola Moto Watch
  • All Garmin models (Venu, Epix Pro, Forerunner, Fenix)
  • Google Pixel Watch

Apple's choice of a rectangular design is the outlier, so it wouldn't be surprising for the company to consider launching a round Apple Watch in the future.

There is a case for a round Apple Watch

The reason Apple originally chose a rectangular design is that it can display more information. This is no accident — every other screen we use daily, whether phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, and so on, is rectangular.

Ultimately, this is a trade-off between aesthetics and practicality. There will always be those who prioritise practicality, so the rectangular Apple Watch design will undoubtedly continue to exist. But there are also plenty of people who place great importance on appearance, and many genuinely have a strong preference for round designs when it comes to both traditional and smartwatches.

Furthermore, not everyone who wears an Apple Watch needs to display a large amount of information on the face. Even if you don't frequently check the screen, there are still plenty of good reasons to wear an Apple Watch. For example:

  • Health and fitness monitoring
  • Sleep tracking
  • Emergency features, such as fall detection
  • Contactless payment

Of the above, health and fitness monitoring is the primary reason for many people; if you mainly don't use your Apple Watch as a content device, then a round screen would actually work perfectly fine for you.

But the case for an Apple Ring is even stronger

However, if you're the type of user who primarily uses an Apple Watch for health and fitness monitoring, and basically never uses it to check information, then I believe a smart ring would be the more… sensible choice.

I personally switched from the Apple Watch to the Oura smart ring back in 2024, and have recently upgraded to the fifth-generation model. I love how understated it is, allowing me to wear my favourite traditional watch, and it only needs charging once a week.

Almost two years ago to the day, I stated that the smart ring had successfully replaced the Apple Watch as my favourite, and that Apple should launch a similar product. My view hasn't changed since, and Gurman notes that Eddy Cue is also a staunch supporter of the smart ring, making it seem like a matter of course.

I do think it's possible that Apple will release a round Apple Watch model, but I'm even more looking forward to seeing an Apple Ring come to fruition. What do you think? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

已退休的大律師吳靄儀，在 8.18 流水式集會案涉參與未經批准集結罪成，判監 9 個月、緩刑兩年，被大律師公會投訴專業失當，大律師紀律審裁組今年 6 月以大比數裁定投訴不成立。大律師公會執委會上周五（7 日）提司法覆核，要求法庭推翻判決、宣告投訴成立，並下令審裁組向吳發信訓誡、或發還由其他人組成的審裁組重新考慮。 大律師公會指，審裁組指吳靄儀的行為不應受道德譴責亦並非可恥，是與原審裁決抵觸、對刑事法庭的附帶攻擊，又強調吳的行為向公眾發放錯誤訊息，在政治動盪時期，大律師也可接受公然漠視法律的行為，為港人樹立壞榜樣。《集誌社》就事件向吳靄儀查詢，她以短訊回覆指 「不予置評」（no comments） 。

2021 年，吳靄儀被裁在 8.18 流水式集會案，參與未經批准集結罪成。（資料相片）

專業失當投訴不成立

申請人為大律師公會執行委員會，擬答辯人為由資深大律師郭莎樂、大律師趙芷筠及施麗珊組成的大律師紀律審裁組，利害關係方為吳靄儀。

根據入稟狀，吳靄儀自 1988 年成為大律師，執業至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，在 8.18 流水式集會案被裁明知而參與未經批准集結罪成，判監 9 個月、緩刑兩年。大律師公會指吳的行為可能損害大律師聲譽，或削弱公眾對大律師專業的信心，違反《行為守則》，但大律師紀律審裁組今年 6 月 8 日，以大比數裁定該投訴不成立。

申請方：審裁組裁決與原審抵觸

入稟狀指，審裁組裁定投訴不成立，是根本上出錯，大律師公會為履行監管職責及促進公眾信心提出司法覆核。申請方引原審法官指，眾被告蓄意藐視法律、以「疏散人群」的虛假藉口繞過禁令，有預謀挑戰警方權威、法律及秩序，在動盪時期刻意違法及挑戰公共秩序，認為涉案罪行嚴重及不可接受，尤其當行為是由被公眾期望尊重和維護法治的大律師所干犯。

申請方續指，審裁組錯誤自我引導及誤解法律原則，未有集中考慮吳有否違反大律師公會的《行為守則》，而是抽象考慮有否「專業失當」；而審裁組裁定吳的犯罪行為不應受道德譴責亦並非可恥，是與原審裁決相抵觸、對刑事法庭裁決不被允許的「附帶攻擊」（collateral attack）。

申請方又認為，審裁組錯誤考慮吳靄儀的政治動機，指法庭一向嚴謹應用法律、亦必須將政治排除在司法程序之外，審裁組考慮其政治動機並以此合理化其行為，已超越法律分析恰當允許的範圍。而即使按審裁組邏輯，吳靄儀相信她在做正確的事，但根據案例，對法律知情而刻意的挑戰、即使背後有值得讚揚的理由，仍會損害律師專業聲譽及構成專業失當，何況吳靄儀是選擇不依循合法途徑、按自己意願行使公義（take the law into her own hands）以推動其政治動機，令香港社會嚴重分裂。

8.18 流水式集會案中，梁國雄、黎智英、李卓人、吳靄儀、何俊仁、李柱銘及何秀蘭七人在原審，被裁定「組織未經批准集結」及「明知而參與未經批准集結」兩罪成，判囚 8 至 18 個月，其中李柱銘、吳靄儀、何俊仁獲判緩刑；「組織未經批准集結罪」定罪其後上訴得直。

申請方：吳靄儀公然違法樹立壞榜樣

對於審裁組指，吳靄儀的罪行與其大律師身分欠足夠關聯。申請方同認為錯誤，引原審提到案中有 3 名被告受過法律訓練、是非常有經驗的律師，無疑對《公安條例》熟悉。申請方指當中必然包括吳靄儀，而當 3 名律師被公眾目睹持橫額帶領非法遊行，向公眾發放的訊息，就是即使經驗豐富的律師，亦不認為蓄意及明知違法有任何問題，此舉會損害香港法治，監管大律師的機構亦絕不能容忍。

申請方又指，審裁組似乎暗示，因吳靄儀將大部分時間投入立法會，因此其行為與其大律師專業無關。但申請方指，投訴重點並非吳靄儀將多少時間投入大律師執業，而正正因為吳是知名政治人物、公眾皆知道她具有大律師資格，因此她錯誤而不可接受、凌駕法律的行為，會向公眾發放完全錯誤的訊息，尤其在動盪及政治情緒高漲的時期，就是只要主觀上不認同法律內容，並相信在做正確的事，即使是經驗豐富的大律師及曾經的法律界議員，也可接受公然漠視法律的行為，認為這無疑為港人、尤其是支持吳政見的人樹立壞榜樣。

吳靄儀、何俊仁、李柱銘等七人就參與未經批准集會罪成上訴至終審法院，爭議檢控、定罪損害集會自由，在 2024 年被駁回。（資料相片）

要求法庭推翻判決、下令訓誡

大律師公會最後指，理解吳靄儀自 2025 年底已退休，但強調糾正根本的法律錯誤對公眾利益仍然重要，以維護公眾對大律師專業的信心。公會要求法庭推翻審裁組判決，宣告針對吳靄儀的投訴成立，並下令審裁組向吳靄儀發信訓誡，或下令將投訴交由不同人士組成的審裁組重新考慮。而即使司法覆核勝訴，申請方亦不會申請訟費。

林超英：香港暑熱指數沒處理露天太陽曬

林超英指，香港暑熱指數避開了露天工作情況，沒處理露天太陽曬的情況。他指出，所有的數個，都是用三組數字，分別為氣温、黑球、濕球温度，只是比重不同。

勞工處回覆查詢指，氣溫只是熱壓力的其中一項風險因素，其他因素還有濕度、風速和太陽照射等，處方提倡使用「香港暑熱指數」制定的工作暑熱警告，「不是單以氣溫」評估熱壓力風險。

勞工處：增加了濕度參數比重

勞工處指，「香港暑熱指數」計算的方程式，考慮因素基本與「濕球黑球溫度指數」相同。兩者的分別是，有關環境溫度、濕度、空氣流動及太陽熱輻射水平等因素的加權比例「稍有分別」，「香港暑熱指數」因應本港夏季較潮濕，增加了濕度參數比重。

勞工處又指本地學者分析了「香港暑熱指數」與急症室非意外入院數據，發現當「香港暑熱指數」達約30或以上時，市民需住院風險明顯增加。勞工處認為，「香港暑熱指數」適用於全港性的工作暑熱警告系統。

勞工處指，制定工作暑熱警告臨界值時，以工人在不同情況下工作，都不會令身體核心溫度上升至超過攝氏38度為大原則。因為，當身體核心溫度超過 38 度，就可能會顯著增加中暑的風險。勞工處表示，會密切留意暑熱天氣以及「工作暑熱警告」系統的運作情況，檢視系統是否需要再作進一步優化。
